scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.release: npm run build -w @cc/web -- --outDir ../../site --emptyOutDir && node scripts/copy-runtime.mjs site
scripts.build:single: SINGLE_FILE=1 npm run build && node scripts/single-file.mjs apps/web/dist/casual-colonization.html
scripts.tournament: rolldown scripts/tournament.ts --file scripts/.tournament.mjs --format esm --platform node --log-level warn && node scripts/.tournament.mjs
scripts.bench: rolldown scripts/bench.ts --file scripts/.bench.mjs --format esm --platform node --log-level warn && node scripts/.bench.mjs
